translationRepairs: Within his jurisdiction he held sole authority over offenses up to and including capital crimes.
Within his jurisdiction he held sole authority over offenses short of capital crimes.
死罪以下 means offenses below the capital grade, so sole jurisdiction stops short of capital crimes; the original 'up to and including capital crimes' overstates the authority.
On wuzi day in the ninth month he executed xiangwen Balu, Zhuahen Du, and two others.
On wuzi day in the ninth month he executed xiangwen Balu, yila Hendun, and two others.
詳穩八剌、拽剌痕篤 pairs office title with personal name in each case; 拽剌 is the yila office and 痕篤 the name, so Zhuahen Du wrongly fuses them.
That night attendants Xiaoge, washer Huage, cook Xingu, and six others in all rebelled; the Emperor met assassination at age thirty-nine; his temple name was Muzong.
That night attendants Xiaoge, washer Huage, cook Xingu, and three others — six men in all — rebelled; the Emperor met assassination at age thirty-nine; his temple name was Muzong.
等六人 counts six rebels in all, including the three named attendants; 'six others in all' wrongly adds six more people.
